text: By David. A psalm: The earth is ADONAI’s, with all that is in it, the world and those who live there;
for he set its foundations on the seas and established it on the rivers.
Who may go up to the mountain of ADONAI? Who can stand in his holy place?
Those with clean hands and pure hearts, who don’t make vanities the purpose of their lives or swear oaths just to deceive.
They will receive a blessing from ADONAI and justice from God, who saves them.
Such is the character of those who seek him, of Ya‘akov, who seeks your face. (Selah)
Lift up your heads, you gates! Lift them up, everlasting doors, so that the glorious king can enter!
Who is he, this glorious king? ADONAI, strong and mighty, ADONAI, mighty in battle.
Lift up your heads, you gates! Lift them up, everlasting doors, so that the glorious king can enter!
Who is he, this glorious king? ADONAI-Tzva’ot — he is the glorious king. (Selah)
